product_one_liner.value: Neostella provides connected enterprise legal case-management software that brings cases, documents, workflows, communications, reporting, and AI together for growing and enterprise legal teams.
product_one_liner.notes: The platform page describes a connected platform bringing cases, documents, workflows, communications, reporting, and AI together for growing and enterprise legal teams.

pricing_page.notes: The company has a public legal-software pricing page describing its packages, pricing model, and related FAQ.

named_customers.notes: named_customers: Neostella’s customer testimonial identifies Aylstock, Witkin, Kreis & Overholtz, and its platform-launch announcement quotes Bell Legal Group’s managing partner as a customer. | named_customers.0: The customer quote identifies Aylstock, Witkin, Kreis & Overholtz as the customer. | named_customers.1: The launch announcement identifies Bell Legal Group through a quoted managing partner.

employee_band.notes: The Neostella company profile reports an official employee count of 313, which falls in the 201-500 band.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: The official About page explicitly labels the Milwaukee office as Neostella, Inc. HQ. | hq_country: The official About page labels Milwaukee as HQ and gives its address as Milwaukee, Wisconsin, USA.

founded_year.notes: Neostella’s official About page states “founded in 2019.”

eng_blog.notes: The blog index lists general legal-operations, workflow, technology, and company-story articles; it does not show the required engineering/technical blog with at least two build-focused posts by engineers.

public_docs.notes: Neostella’s public Support Center has numerous product help topics, integrations resources, technical reference materials, and release notes.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The current Workable board lists ten open jobs, and none of the listed titles is an AI, ML, or data-science role.

model_provider.notes: Neostella’s March 2026 product release notes say OpenAI credentials are automatically configured during tenant provisioning to activate AI features, identifying OpenAI as a provider used by the product.

compliance_certs.notes: compliance_certs: Neostella’s Trust Center Compliance section names SOC 2 Type II, HIPAA, and GDPR. | compliance_certs.0: The Trust Center explicitly names SOC 2 Type II. | compliance_certs.1: The Trust Center explicitly names HIPAA. | compliance_certs.2: The Trust Center explicitly names GDPR.

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: The Neostella profile identifies the latest round as Series B. | funding_date: The Neostella profile gives the latest round date as May 23, 2025; the requested YYYY-MM representation is 2025-05. | funding_amount_usd: The Neostella profile lists the latest funding amount as USD 10,700,000.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest round is dated May 23, 2025, within the 18 months before November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The live job board includes a Director, Business Development Representatives posting and an Account Executive posting.

launched_6mo.notes: Neostella’s May 15, 2026 announcement says it introduced new platform capabilities, which is within the six months before November 9, 2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Samm Karshenas’s profile lists a current Neostella VP, Partner Apps role starting April 1, 2026, within the 12-month window.

crm_stack_signal.notes: crm_stack_signal: The Trust Center subprocessor list identifies Salesforce as CRM and sales automation and Hubspot as CRM, marketing, and sales automation. | crm_stack_signal.0: The subprocessor list names Salesforce and describes its CRM and sales automation role. | crm_stack_signal.1: The subprocessor list names Hubspot and describes its CRM, marketing, and sales automation role.
